_about: Photos of nutrient deficiency symptoms from Bugwood Images (bugwood.org), used for non-commercial education. Bugwood requires the citation (Photographer, Organization, Bugwood.org) to accompany each image wherever it is shown. Fields set to null still need filling in.

images.description: Close-up of interveinal chlorosis due to iron deficiency
images.credit: John Hartman, University of Kentucky, Bugwood.org

images.description: Yellowing and browning along leaf margins on older leaves
images.credit: Daren Mueller, Iowa State University, Bugwood.org

images.description: Zinc deficiency. Shortening of internodes and light streaking of leaves followed by a broad stripe of bleached tissue on each side of the midrib. Occasionally the leaf edges and interior of the stalks at the nodes appear purplish.
images.credit: Diane Perkins, University of Kentucky, Bugwood.org
images._note: License still to be confirmed (shown just under the photo on its Bugwood page).

images.description: Calcium deficiency in cabbage: characteristic tip burn at the tips and edges of the leaves; leaves become deformed and the head will not form without supplemental calcium.
images.credit: David B. Langston, University of Georgia, Bugwood.org
